scenes.spoken: Your phone lights up at midnight. Your new hire wants to spend. Would you hand them the company card?
scenes.display: Your phone lights up at midnight. Your new hire wants to spend. Would you hand them the company card?

scenes.spoken: A public post looks useful. Hidden inside: an order to send the budget away. That is the trap.
scenes.display: A public post looks useful. Hidden inside: an order to send the budget away. That is the trap.

scenes.spoken: Here is AutoNEAR. You choose what it watches. You set the card's limit, and you can stop it.
scenes.display: Here is AutoNEAR. You choose what it watches. You set the card's limit, and you can stop it.

scenes.spoken: It reads public signals and shows its work. This snapshot has three hundred and six records. One promising idea still gets a low-confidence warning.
scenes.display: It reads public signals and shows its work. This snapshot has 306 records. One promising idea still gets a low-confidence warning.

scenes.spoken: The council weighs the evidence. Seven roles prepare a brief, check the build, and leave a request for the owner.
scenes.display: The council weighs the evidence. 7 roles prepare a brief, check the build, and leave a request for the owner.

scenes.spoken: The owner reviews the exact request and holds to approve. Approval is a decision. The next action still has to pass its checks.
scenes.display: The owner reviews the exact request and holds to approve. Approval is a decision. The next action still has to pass its checks.

scenes.spoken: Now a result comes back with the wrong code. AutoNEAR refuses to record that deployment. The matching result passes.
scenes.display: Now a result comes back with the wrong code. AutoNEAR refuses to record that deployment. The matching result passes.

scenes.spoken: This also ran on NEAR testnet. A demo owner capped a vault, the agent deployed through it, and the chain refused it four times when it pushed past its limits.
scenes.display: This also ran on NEAR testnet. A demo owner capped a vault, the agent deployed through it, and the chain refused it 4 times when it pushed past its limits.
